question:
If the difference between the compound interest and the simple interest on a certain sum of money for 3 years at the rate of 4% per annum is ₹76, then what is the sum?

(CHSL 2023 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 15,625.
For 3 year difference (D) between CI and SI = \(\frac{D}{P}=\ \left(\frac{r}{100}\right)^2\left(\frac{300\ +\ r}{100}\right)\)

⇒ \(\frac{76}{P}=\ \left(\frac{4}{100}\right)^2\left(\frac{300\ +\ 4}{100}\right)\)
⇒ \(\frac{76}{P}=\frac{1}{625}\times\frac{304}{100}\) 
⇒ \(\frac{1}{P}=\frac{1}{625}\times\frac{1}{25}\) 
⇒ P = ₹15625

यदि एक निश्चित धनराशि पर 3 वर्ष के लिए 4% वार्षिक दर से चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज और साधारण ब्याज के बीच का अंतर ₹76 है, तो वह धनराशि ज्ञात कीजिए।

(CHSL 2023 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात 15,625 है।
3 वर्ष के लिए चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज और साधारण ब्याज के बीच अंतर (D) = \(\frac{D}{P}=\ \left(\frac{r}{100}\right)^2\left(\frac{300\ +\ r}{100}\right)\)

⇒ \(\frac{76}{P}=\ \left(\frac{4}{100}\right)^2\left(\frac{300\ +\ 4}{100}\right)\)
⇒ \(\frac{76}{P}=\frac{1}{625}\times\frac{304}{100}\) 
⇒ \(\frac{1}{P}=\frac{1}{625}\times\frac{1}{25}\) 
⇒ P = ₹15625

question:
If the difference between the compound interest and simple interest on a certain sum of money for three years at 10% p.a. is ₹558, then the sum is:

(CHSL 2019 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. ₹18,000.

SI = 10 × 3 = 30%

CI (2 year) = 10 + 10 + \(\frac{10\ \times\ 10}{100}\) = 21%  

CI (3 years) = 21+10 + \(\frac{21\ \times\ 10}{100}\) = 33.1%

Difference = 33.1 – 30 = 3.1% 

⇒ 3.1% = 558 

⇒ 1% = 180 

Sum = 100% = ₹18000

यदि किसी निश्चित धनराशि पर 10% प्रति वर्ष की दर से तीन वर्ष में चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज और साधारण ब्याज के बीच अंतर ₹558 है, तो धनराशि ज्ञात करें। 

(CHSL 2019 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात ₹18,000 है।

साधारण ब्याज = 10 × 3 = 30%

चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज (2 वर्ष) = 10 + 10 + \(\frac{10\ \times\ 10}{100}\)= 21%

चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज (3 वर्ष) = 21 + 10 + \(\frac{21\ \times\ 10}{100}\)= 33.1%

अंतर = 33.1 – 30 = 3.1%

⇒ 3.1% = 558

⇒ 1% = 180

धनराशि = 100% = ₹18000

question:
If the difference between the compound interest and simple interest at 17% on a sum of money for 2 years (compounded annually) is ₹433.50. then the compound interest (in ₹) is:

(СРО 2020 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 5,533.50.

x + y + \(\frac{xy}{100}\) = C.I. 
Here, difference of S.I. and C.I. for 2 year = \(\frac{xy}{100}\)= 2.89% 
⇒ 2.89% = 433.5 
⇒ 1% = 150 
C.I. = 17 + 17 + 2.89 = 36.89%
⇒ 36.89% = 150 × 36.89 = ₹5533.50

(CPO 2020 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 अर्थात 5,533.50 है।

x + y + \(\frac{xy}{100}\) = चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज
यहाँ, SI और CI का अंतर 2 वर्ष = \(\frac{xy}{100}\)= 2.89% 
⇒ 2.89% = 433.5 
⇒ 1% = 150 
चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज = 17+17+2.89 = 36.89%
⇒ 36.89% = 150 × 36.89 = ₹5533.50

question:
What is the difference (in ₹) between the simple interest and the compound interest on a sum of ₹8000 for 2\(\frac{2}{5}\) years at the rate of 10% p.a.. when the interest is compounded yearly?

(CGL 2020 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 147.20.

S.l.= 10 × \(\frac{12}{5}\) = 24% 
Rate for C.I.= 10%
CI for 2 years = 10 + 10 + \(\frac{10\times10}{100}\) = 21% 
\(\frac{2}{5}\) × 10 = 4%
CI for whole time = 21 + 4 + \(\frac{21\ \times\ 4}{100}\) = 25.84% 
Difference (25.84 – 24)% = 1.84% 
Value of difference = 8000 × \(\frac{1.84}{100}\) = ₹147.2
question_hi:
₹8000 की राशि पर 10% वार्षिक दर से 2\(\frac{2}{5}\) वर्ष में प्राप्त साधारण ब्याज और चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज के बीच अंतर (₹ में) ज्ञात करें।

(CGL 2020 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 अर्थात 147.20 है।

साधारण ब्याज = 10 × \(\frac{12}{5}\)= 24%
चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज की दर= 10%
2 वर्षों के लिए चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज = 10 + 10 + \(\frac{10\times10}{100}\) = 21%
\(\frac{2}{5}\) × 10 = 4%

पूरे समय के लिए चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज = 21 + 4 + \(\frac{21\ \times\ 4}{100}\) = 25.84%
अंतर (25.84 – 24)% = 1.84%
मूल्यों का अंतर = 8000 × \(\frac{1.84}{100}\)= ₹147.2

question:

(CGL 2019 Pre)
solution:

⇒ R= 8%

(CGL 2019 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात 8% है।
2 वर्षों के लिए चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज और साधारण ब्याज के बीच अंतर (d) = P\(\left(\frac{R}{100}\right)^2\)
⇒ 160 = \(\frac{25000\ \times\ R^2}{{100}^2}\) 
⇒ दर = 8%

question:
A man borrowed Rs.50,000 from a bank at 10% per annum, compounded annually. At the end of every year, he pays Rs.15,000 as part payment of the loan and interest. How much does he still owe to the bank after three such installments?

(СРО 2022 Pre)
solution:

question:

question:
A person borrowed a certain sum at 10% p.a. for three years, interest being compounded annually. At the end of two years, he repaid a sum of ₹6,634 and at the end of the third year, be cleared off the debt by paying ₹13,200. What was the sum borrowed by him? 

(CGL 2018 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. ₹15,400.

Rate = 10% = \(\frac{1}{10}\)

1st year = 10%

2nd year = 10 + 10 + 100/100 = 21%

Amount after 2nd year = 121%

(121% - 6634) × \(\frac{11}{10}\) = 13200

(121% - 6634) = 12000

100% = (18634/121) × 100 = 15400
question_hi:
किसी व्यक्ति ने एक निश्चित राशि 10% वार्षिक दर पर तीन वर्ष के लिए उधार ली, जबकि ब्याज वार्षिक संयोजित था। दो वर्ष पश्चात् उसने ₹6634 का भुगतान किया और तीसरे वर्ष के अंत में उसने ₹13200 का भुगतान करके पूरा ऋण चुका दिया। उसके द्वारा उधार ली गई राशि थी: 

(CGL 2018 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात ₹15,400 है।

दर = 10% = \(\frac{1}{10}\)

पहला वर्ष = 10%

दूसरा वर्ष = 10 + 10 + 100/100 = 21%

दूसरे वर्ष के बाद राशि = 121%

(121% - 6634) × \(\frac{11}{10}\) = 13200

(121% - 6634) = 12000

100% = (18634/121) × 100 = 15400

question:
The compound interest (compounding annually) on a certain sum at the rate of 8 percent per annum for two years is ₹6656. What would be the simple interest on the same sum at the same rate of interest for two years?

(CGL MAINS 2021)
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. ₹6400.

CI for 2 years at 8% per annum = \(\left(8+8+\frac{8\times8}{100}\right)%\) = 16.64% 
⇒ P × 16.64% = 6656 
⇒ P = ₹40000 
SI = \(\frac{40000\ \times\ 8\ \times\ 2}{100}\)= ₹6400
question_hi:
एक निश्चित राशि पर 8 प्रतिशत प्रति वर्ष की दर से 2 वर्षों के लिए चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज (वार्षिक रूप से चक्रवृद्धि किए जाने पर) ₹6656 है। समान राशि पर समान ब्याज की दर से दो वर्षों के लिए साधारण ब्याज क्या होगा?

(CGL MAINS 2021)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात ₹6400 है।

2 वर्षों के लिए 8% प्रति वर्ष की दर से चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज = \(\left(8+8+\frac{8\times8}{100}\right)%\) = 16.64%

⇒ P = ₹40000 
साधारण ब्याज = \(\frac{40000\ \times\ 8\ \times\ 2}{100}\)= ₹6400

question:

question:
The sum of the simple interest and the compound interest on ₹5,600 at the same rate of interest per annum for two years is ₹2,061.36, when in the case of compound interest, it is compounded annually. What is the rate of interest per annum?

(MTS 2021)
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 9%.

(A) 2 years SI + 2 years CI 

2 × 12% + 12% + 12% + (12 × 12)/100

⇒ 24% + 25.44% = 49.44% 

⇒ 5600 × \(\frac{49}{100}\) = 2744 (✘) 

(B) 2 years SI + 2 years CI 

= 2 × 9% + 9% + 9% + (9 × 9)/100

= 18% + 18.81% = 36.81%

⇒ 5600 × \(\frac{37}{100}\) = 2072 (near to 2061.36)

.:. Rate = 9% p.a
question_hi:

(MTS 2021)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात 9% है।

(A) 2 वर्ष साधारण ब्याज + 2 वर्ष चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज

2 × 12% + 12% + 12% + (12 × 12)/100

⇒ 24% + 25.44% = 49.44%

⇒ 5600 ×\(\frac{49}{100}\) = 2744 ( ✘ )

(B) 2 वर्ष साधारण ब्याज + 2 वर्ष चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज

= 2 × 9% + 9% + 9% + (9 × 9)/100

= 18% + 18.81% = 36.81%

⇒ 5600 × \(\frac{37}{100}\)= 2072 (2061.36 के करीब)

.:. दर = 9% प्रति वर्ष

question:

question:

⇒ \(\frac{D}{P}\) = \(\left(\frac{R}{100}\right)^2\)

question:

(MTS 2022)
